_comment: Vegeta's own specials, by hand; npm run rom -- states --fighter vegeta merges them into states.json (src/rom/specials.ts). big_bang is move ad, the Big Bang shot upward (owner, 2026-10-31): on the ground, 10 health, its parts mad / mad_2 / mad_3. The flash at the hands (vegeta_flash, mad_2's first frame) is not put out yet. final_flash is move ac (docs/rom.md, Final Flash): 10 health, A held charges — let go before frame 20 the small beam, before 32 the medium, else the large (field f0, $20:9A82); the ball grows 2 a frame from 16 at 24, -46. mac_2 fires head, base and band (size 16 / 12 / 8, never thicker); then move b5 holds the pose, the band still drawn, until the head is gone and 24 / 20 / 16 frames more (jumps to 72 / 76 / 80 of 96). As for Goku's Kamehameha, the charge fires as it decides (the original shows 2 more frames, a jump to frame 42) and the head outlives its thrower's move. sliding_kick is move a4, Sliding Kick, ↓ ↘ → B on the ground; typed again from frame 8 to its end, it is kept and a5 (rushing_knee) follows when a4 is over, and the same from a5 (from frame 1) to a6 (cross_punch, cross_punch_2) — field f0, $20:97c7 / $20:9885. Nothing else is read meanwhile; a miss goes on too. knee_slash is move 9c, Jumping Knee Slash, → ↓ ↘ B on the ground ($20:92DF): at frame 6 vx 1, vy -8 at his own gravity; vx 0 at 24; from 30 it holds frame 31's pose until it lands, then 0c and m9c_4; every blow of it lifts a body into the high knockdown at -6.0, not -7.5 ($0D:D3BF). attack_b and crouch_b are his own handlers ($20:9280, $20:92C9): the far B slides at vx 3 from frame 6 to 24; the crouching B has a second blow, m95_2, re-armed at its start. driving_elbow is move a2, R + Y ($20:9739), as Goku's Side Slash: behind the opponent through step 0, on frame 24 turns and closes on him by a 32nd of the way to 8 px short. ground_flare is a9, ↓ ↑ Y, also from a jump's first 2 frames, still on the floor: its shot stands 48 px ahead. energy_field is ab, ↓ ↙ ← Y in the air: he stops at frame 1 and hangs (gravity off `?`), puts out the field at 0, -40 with sound 19 every 3 ticks for 25 (its object's code, $0F:BBAC — ours this state's loopSound), falls from vy 2 at his own gravity from move frame 42 ($20:9A13; the owner: slower than the original without gravity) and holds frame 47's pose until he lands ($20:9A09). renzoku is aa, ↓ ↘ → A, 5 health: three shots, one a part; its entry goes after Big Bang's, whose roll ends in the same ↓ ↘ → A. vertical_ki is move b1, Vertical Ki, ↓ ↙ ← A in the air ($20:A02C): 5 health; it stops him at frame 0 and he hangs; a shot at 8 (8, 8) and at 24 (-8, 8, the pose flipped), each falling at b0's vy 4 and bursting at y B8 (ADR 0056); vy 2 at 48, his pose 15 held from 49 until he lands. Landed, the handler goes on at frame 56 — pose 13 for 6 frames (vertical_ki_land) — and the move ends; gravity after vy 2 as Energy Field's `?`. jumping_bomb is 9e, Jumping Bomb, ↙ ↗ Y on the ground ($20:95B1, by step): blows pass him by to 16 (its part, cut where field 0x96 changes); at 4 vx 3, vy -8; at 21 vx 5, vy 3 (facing left the code gives 3); at 26 he stops and hangs and puts out his spray where he is; at 48 vx -2, vy -5; stops at 55; at 56 vx -1, vy 4; holds pose 15 until he lands, then idle — gravity after each vy as Energy Field's `?`. energy_dash is a7, Energy Dash, ← ↙ ↓ ↘ → Y ($20:9978): vx 4 from 28, and from frame 12 the opponent under 48 px away makes it a8 (energy_dash_2), the spray where he stands; ours: a rush of speed 0 from 12, then of 4 from 28 until 68 — set down 48 short when it arrives, as a rush is `?`; blows pass him by to 28 (its part). galactic_gunfire is ae, Galactic Gunfire, ↑ ↓ Y on the ground, health 80 or less, within 64 px of an opponent who can be held (grab:64; the command's own range, $0D:F95B) ($20:9B66, rom.md): blows pass him by; the opponent held by $20:9C4D's offsets (npm run rom -- port ae), step 4 at step 3's, as the hold stops at 35 and he stays where he is; vy -9 at 18 (his own gravity `?`), both stopped at 35; at the script's end the opponent is let go into pinned (4a). Then af (gunfire_volley, $20:9D29): he hangs where he is, aiming (drawing 9a, the script's f0 hold) until pinned frees him 8 frames into lying ($0F:A545) then af's 4 frames of 86 (gunfire_volley_aim) — and puts out 18 shots, one a part, by turns 8 and -8 px ahead, 14 up — vegeta_gunfire_shot; blows pass him by ($10:C0FD only in ae — af's field 0x96 is the script's 70). Then b2 (gunfire_rain, $20:9DB6): 18 shots more, one a part; from 150 a ball (b1 kind 2) at 0, -88 grows 1 a frame from 1 while frame 150 is held, 40 frames (field f2), then 182 (gunfire_charged: line 0d, sound 38); from 192 (gunfire_drop) the ball falls 4 px a frame to the floor, frame held; there an explosion grows 2 a frame to 96 (40 + 2 x 28), the band (2), 120 frames white with bursts (gunfire_blast, frame held), then 256 (gunfire_throw): at 264 vy 4 and the throw of the pinned body where it lies, 150 less defence, reel_down (1b), 2.5 / -5 backwards ($0F:B321); lands, 272, ends. Finale and throw: ADR 0058. The band along the floor and 2c in the white are the finale's ($0F:F1BC, F2A0). Not here: the stun gauge's 6. crouch is his own ($20:9139): from frame 43 it goes back to 8, so the crouch breathes through 0c, d0, d1 (crouch_loop, m03_3), not held on one pose as goku's. Charging (0c, $20:91B6) is goku's with his own frames: held, step 5 goes back to 19 — the export cuts his parts there, and the template's charge states play them. The trip (19, $0F:A190, five of the roster's) is goku's ($10:AEB6) lying 6 frames, not 12, before he gets up. throw is 9d, → + X in grab range ($20:9385), his own: he holds the opponent by $20:9435 for 102 frames, striking three times — a spark and 09 from the script, the opponent's cry 30 from the handler, no damage — then throws him ahead, still facing him (40 less defence, reel_down, 2.5 / -8: $0F:B321 given his own facing, not turned as goku's) and recovers in b0 (throw_recover). npm run rom -- grab 9d --fighter vegeta writes the grab. sender_9f / a0 / a1 are 9f (↓ ↘ → X), a0 (→ ← → X) and a1 (↓ ↙ ← X), not in the move lists: their blows (byte 2 bits 0–2, $D3F3/$D46E/$D4D4) send the defender to another part of the arena; with no other part to go to, ours are the closed way's knockdown (1b, down), 24. 9f hops at vx 3, vy -3 from 8, stops at 16 and falls as a jump from 20 (move 05); a0 leaps at 2, -3.5 from 8 until he lands; a1 stands.
